about: PROPOSED, UNSIGNED. One Proofline task, XC-58, part of the 'cover ALL' decomposition (XC-54 to XC-78) drafted on 2026-10-25 from public sources. Nothing here is binding and vv does not read this file. It becomes part of the contract only when the owner merges it into proofline.json and re-signs it with the owner key pinned in guard/owner.pub. Every criterion except scope, pushed and the unchanged-suite guards fails on the v1.6.0 tree. Evidence is testnet-only, loopback-only and verify-only unless the task says otherwise; hosted facilitators are never called. Estimated effort: 2-3 days.

not_contract_tasks.keys: Throwaway testnet keys and faucet tokens are created on the owner's machine and live in X402C_KEYS outside the repository. No spend, no mainnet.
not_contract_tasks.disclosure: A failing third-party column is reported to that project privately first (SECURITY.md). Until the window clears its row says 'under disclosure' with no per-check detail.

tasks.title: F15, F16, C4: checks from public findings (malformed input never 5xx, no wildcard network accept, resume never re-pays)
tasks.description: From public issues only: x402-foundation/x402#3929 and the gaps left in PR #3936 (TS `{}` or missing authorization still 500; the library still throws; Python accepts eip155:8453 through an eip155:* registration), #3908 (Python decode raises AttributeError on non-object JSON), #3937/#3938 (Go examples answer 500), and DACS-Agent-commerce/dacs-sdk#43 (session resume can pay twice after a crash between settle and anchor). Each check gets a control and at least one faulty build, per the admission bar.

criteria.statement: F15: a facilitator answers a non-object, empty-object or authorization-less payload with HTTP 400 or isValid false and invalid_payload, never 5xx and never an uncaught library exception; the reference passes and three faulty builds are caught

F16: a facilitator registered only for a testnet answers a requirement for a different network on the same family (eip155:8453 when only eip155:84532 is registered) with isValid false and unsupported_scheme or invalid_network, never a wildcard accept

C4: a client that resumes a job after a crash between settle and its own record reuses the settled result and never signs a second payment for the same job key; a faulty client that drops the key is caught
F15 and F16 run in the parity vector set for every SDK
docs/COVERAGE.md lists F15, F16 and C4
The full offline suite passes unchanged
Every changed file is inside this task's scope

stop_rules: If a criterion cannot pass, STOP and report what blocks it, what was tried and what is needed. Never weaken a criterion, skip a test or raise a timeout to make it pass.

Testnet only: never use a mainnet CAIP-2 id, never fund a key with anything but testnet faucet tokens, never call a hosted facilitator; every facilitator under test is the owner's own instance on 127.0.0.1.
A failing third-party result is not published with per-check detail until SECURITY.md's disclosure window clears; if a criterion would need that detail to pass, STOP and report.
